questions.q: What is a poverty trap according to Sachs?
a: A self‑reinforcing cycle that prevents escape
questions.why: Defines poverty trap as a vicious cycle keeping countries poor.

questions.q: How can geography create a poverty trap?
a: High transport costs from deserts or mountains
questions.why: Cites geography like deserts or mountains raising transport costs.

questions.q: What caused Bolivia's hyperinflation in the 1980s?
a: Spending beyond means on gas and oil
questions.why: Explains overspending on gas/oil led to currency devaluation.

questions.q: What first priority does Sachs recommend for poor countries?
questions.why: States Sachs says canceling debt is the first priority.

questions.q: Why can a single solution not end poverty everywhere?
a: All countries share the same resources
questions.why: Emphasizes no one‑size‑fits‑all solution; problems are individual.
